questions.question: What was our total net revenue in 2025?
questions.reason: Asks for a number (total, revenue / sales, year), so it is computed with SQL.
questions.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue_inr), 2) AS net_revenue_inr
FROM sales s
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_month) = 2025

questions.question: Which region had the highest revenue in 2024?
questions.reason: Asks for a number (ranking, revenue / sales, year), so it is computed with SQL.
questions.sql:
SELECT r.name AS region, ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue_inr), 2) AS net_revenue_inr
FROM sales s
JOIN distributors d ON d.distributor_id = s.distributor_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = d.region_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_month) = 2024
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY net_revenue_inr DESC, region
LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many units of Mango Kulfi did we sell in the West region in 2024?
questions.reason: Asks for a number (how many, units sold, year), so it is computed with SQL.
questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(s.units) AS units
FROM sales s
JOIN distributors d ON d.distributor_id = s.distributor_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = d.region_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_month) = 2024
  AND r.region_id = 'WEST'
  AND s.sku = 'FF-KUL-MNG-60'

questions.question: Top 5 products by units sold in 2025
questions.reason: Asks for a number (top / bottom N, units sold, year), so it is computed with SQL.
questions.sql:
SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(s.units) AS units
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON p.sku = s.sku
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_month) = 2025
GROUP BY product
ORDER BY units DESC, product
LIMIT 5

questions.question: Show monthly revenue for 2025

questions.question: Compare total revenue in 2024 vs 2025
questions.reason: Asks for a number (total, revenue / sales, comparison, year), so it is computed with SQL.

questions.question: How many active products do we have?
questions.reason: Asks for a number (how many), so it is computed with SQL.
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS products
FROM products p
WHERE p.status = 'active'

questions.question: How many quality incidents were high severity?
questions.reason: Asks for a number (how many), so it is computed with SQL.
questions.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS incidents
FROM quality_incidents q
JOIN production_batches b ON b.batch_id = q.batch_id
WHERE q.severity = 'high'

questions.question: How many distributors are in the East region?

questions.question: What was the gross margin on Choco Bar in 2025?
questions.reason: Asks for a number (margin, year), so it is computed with SQL.
questions.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue_inr - s.units * p.unit_cost_inr), 2) AS gross_margin_inr
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON p.sku = s.sku
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_month) = 2025
  AND s.sku = 'FF-STK-CHO-70'

questions.question: Net revenue by product category in Q2 2025
questions.reason: Asks for a number (revenue / sales, breakdown, quarter, year), so it is computed with SQL.
questions.sql:
SELECT p.category AS category, ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue_inr), 2) AS net_revenue_inr
FROM sales s
JOIN products p ON p.sku = s.sku
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_month) = 2025
  AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.sale_month) = 2
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY net_revenue_inr DESC, category

questions.question: How many units did the Pune Plant produce in 2025?
questions.reason: Asks for a number (how many, units sold, year), so it is computed with SQL.
questions.sql:
SELECT SUM(b.units) AS units_produced
FROM production_batches b
JOIN plants pl ON pl.plant_id = b.plant_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.produced_on) = 2025
  AND pl.plant_id = 'P02'
